events.title: Frederick Barbarossa drowns on the Third Crusade
events.description: The Holy Roman Emperor drowned in the Saleph river in Anatolia while leading his army to the Holy Land. Much of the German crusading force broke up after his death.
events.html: The Holy Roman Emperor drowned in the Saleph river in Anatolia while leading his army to the Holy Land. Much of the German crusading force broke up after his death.

events.title: Pope Honorius III approves a Dominican mission to Morocco
events.description: In the bull Vineae Domini custodes, Pope Honorius III approved a mission to Morocco, then part of the Almohad empire, asked for by the friars Dominic of Segovia and Martin. Its call to convert Muslims broke with earlier papal policy.
events.html: In the bull Vineae Domini custodes, Pope Honorius III approved a mission to Morocco, then part of the Almohad empire, asked for by the friars Dominic of Segovia and Martin. Its call to convert Muslims broke with earlier papal policy.

events.title: The Ottomans defeat a Byzantine army at Pelekanon
events.description: An Ottoman army led by Orhan I defeated a Byzantine expeditionary force under Andronikos III at the Battle of Pelekanon. No further attempt was made to relieve the cities in Anatolia under Ottoman siege, and Nicaea fell in 1331.
events.html: An Ottoman army led by Orhan I defeated a Byzantine expeditionary force under Andronikos III at the Battle of Pelekanon. No further attempt was made to relieve the cities in Anatolia under Ottoman siege, and Nicaea fell in 1331.

events.title: Sultan Murad II lays siege to Constantinople
events.description: Ottoman Sultan Murad II laid siege to Constantinople, the Byzantine capital, after Emperor Manuel II had tried to interfere in the Ottoman succession following Mehmed I's death. The siege failed; the city fell to Murad's son Mehmed II in 1453.

events.title: Bridget Bishop is hanged in the Salem witch trials
events.description: Bridget Bishop was the first person executed in the Salem witch trials. By September eighteen more had been hanged, and one man had been pressed to death.
events.html: Bridget Bishop was the first person executed in the Salem witch trials. By September eighteen more had been hanged, and one man had been pressed to death.

events.title: National Museum of Natural History is founded in Paris
events.description: The Convention reorganised the royal botanical garden as the Muséum national d'histoire naturelle. Scientists there, including Lamarck and Cuvier, transformed biology and palaeontology.
events.html: The Convention reorganised the royal botanical garden as the Muséum national d'histoire naturelle. Scientists there, including Lamarck and Cuvier, transformed biology and palaeontology.

events.title: SS troops massacre the village of Oradour-sur-Glane
events.description: A Waffen-SS unit killed 643 people in the French village, shooting the men and burning women and children in the church. The ruins are preserved as a memorial.
events.html: A Waffen-SS unit killed 643 people in the French village, shooting the men and burning women and children in the church. The ruins are preserved as a memorial.

events.title: Six-Day War ends in a ceasefire
events.description: Fighting ended with Israel holding Sinai, Gaza, the West Bank, East Jerusalem and the Golan Heights. The status of these territories has remained central to the conflict ever since.
events.html: Fighting ended with Israel holding Sinai, Gaza, the West Bank, East Jerusalem and the Golan Heights. The status of these territories has remained central to the conflict ever since.
